title: Source-technical dynamic relational comparison contract — structural transition priority
status: Proposed source equation and lawful-transition comparison schema; no assumed physical measurements/units or derived equivalence
aim: Make cross-domain physics models mechanically comparable at the level of dynamic relational operations, while separately recording externally justified mathematical/physical claims.

mandatoryPaperModelRecord.originalTitle: Required full paper title and original authors (names verified)

exactMathLocator: definition number / equation number / page numbers; not merely a DOI

modelScope.physicalClaims: exact claim and current independent evidence, not implication of topic title
modelScope.formalDomain: exact admissible typed relational states, event classes, chosen equivalence and scope; do not presume metric or observational coordinates
modelScope.relevantCounterexample: at least one source negative or counterexample, if available

types: e.g. nodes, hyperedges, ports, cells, edges, tensor states, charges, maps
labelsAndSymmetries: renaming of nodes, environment, gauge/references, orientations

eventEnablement: complete guards, not just diagram adjacency
transitionRule: exact equation or algorithm, including read/write/delete/create operations
compositionRule: commutation/conflict/higher-order coherence, not only pairwise tensor
observerAccess: permitted structural source-state perturbations and event choices
relational successor histories and context-sensitive reachability
NOT a measured quantity, physically scaled detector, assigned time coordinate or inferred observation units

mappingToNativeCausalStep.representationMap: native event occurrence -> source model typed action, declared or absent
mappingToNativeCausalStep.equivalenceRelation: preservation of admitted typed relations, event-occurrence identity, enabling predicates and legal transition/composition structure under explicitly specified renaming/equivalence; never a numeric/empirical closeness criterion
mappingToNativeCausalStep.reverseRecoveryOrCounterexample: proof, exact finite witness, or failure
mappingToNativeCausalStep.statefulInterferenceAndTripleComposition: must account for T4 83 state-sensitive pair signatures and 660 blocked triples
independentNulls: pairwise-only matching with different higher-order response
same scalar entropy/homology but different events
mappingToNativeCausalStep.commutingOperationalDiagram: R(T_native(s,e)) ≅ T_external(R(s),F_s(e)) for stated states/admissible events, with an explicit condition on enabled events in both systems; map may be partial or multi-step and failures must be recorded
mappingToNativeCausalStep.higherCompositionWitness: Check event identity, creation/deletion and T4 state-sensitive pair/triple composition, not a match to statistics or diagram appearance.

physicalEvidence.status: separate archived context only; EXCLUDED from source-level structural similarity and mapping gate
physicalEvidence.originalPhysicsSources: Kept under existing source registries/observational falsification files without fabricating a premetric observable.
physicalEvidence.futureEmpiricalQuestion: No physical-unit comparison can be grounded until a separate effective theory establishes its observables and scales; outside current study scope.

nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.formalDomain: 7 selected frozen rule contexts, k=3/4/5 observational scopes, node bit vectors, distinct unordered hyperedge occurrences; not an underlying physical arity/dimensional bound.
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.sourceEventEnabling: Full-rank edge occurrence is eligible iff alive, unfired, and sum(source bits) belongs to the rule's allowed Hamming weights.
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.sourceEventEffect: Mark fired; may remove from alive set; mutate source bits according to original selected mutation; produce one newborn with state determined by rule and input weight; create offspring hyperedges at allowed ranks consisting of newborn and selected old participants.
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.actualNoMetric: No initial metric, Hilbert state, actual force, mass, field or physical dimension is present in this frozen source.
sourceKnownFailures: Every fired step forces a newborn, so node growth is not independent emergence
660 initial pairwise commuting triples can fail to compose
k5/#81 periodic FIFO local tail and k4/#21 scheduler dependence
nativeSourceReferenceRecordExample.technicalFidelity: source code and T1–T4 exact finite tests exist; no external physical equivalence achieved

processRule: Every comparison must cite original relational objects, full admissibility guards, exact source/target transition equations, higher-event composition, specified structural equivalence, preserved and lost relational behavior, and concrete failure cases. No source relation is matched by numerical measurements, physical units, curve fitting or resemblance of scalar summaries.
premetricBoundary: Never preload time/distance, metric, dimension, mass, energy, entropy pressure, Hilbert state or physical measurement units into primitive source to force a mathematical match. Formal test cardinalities/equalities validate structural statements only.

controllingMethodCorrection.requirement: Compare relational structures and how lawful transitions change and compose those relationships. Physical measurements, scales and units cannot identify primordial common structure.
excludedDiscriminators: physical measurements and observed numerical amplitudes
any quantity requiring an assumed physical unit, distance, physical time, spatial dimensionality, energy or mass
regression, fitted astronomical curves, matching a gravitational acceleration, apparent mass, lensing magnitude or entropy value
similar graph images, node/edge counts or static scalar operator spectra without source-transition preservation
allowedFormalChecks: exact typed relationship incidence and source-state predicates
exact rule enabling, source action, new relation creation and deletion
event-occurrence identity, history dependence, causal interference and true higher-order composition
counterexample-based noninjectivity or finite exact algebraic/rewrite proof
renaming/groupoid/gauge maps only under their own declared structural equivalence
bisimulation/simulation or explicitly partial process correspondence where source event histories are faithfully mapped
controllingMethodCorrection.formalNumbersNotPhysicalMeasurements: Finite counts/hashes/exact scalar invariants may certify a mathematical proof or detect collisions, but do not serve as proxy physical observations or basis of cross-theory resemblance.
